title: Kirk McConnell confirms blue-on-blue firefight and human transport in reverse-engineered craft
place_text: SOL conference; Senate Armed Services Committee

tellings.quote: Yeah, because at Soul he was asked by a couple individuals if he had heard of a blue-on-blue firefight team with a locky brushal team and about you know transporting humans in reverse engineered craft and he said both he had heard yes.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, tells about Kirk McConnell, a staff member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, the US Senate panel that oversees the military. According to UAPGerb, at a conference called SOL, people asked McConnell whether he had heard of a "blue-on-blue" firefight, meaning American teams fighting each other, and of humans being carried in "reverse-engineered craft", vehicles built by copying recovered non-human technology, and he said he had heard of both. If true, it would mean a congressional insider had heard of secret craft programmes being real enough to fight over.
